integrity: The full theorem is supported by an analytic proof; a standard-library rational/Monte Carlo verifier gives supplementary checks. Independent scientific review and publication-priority certification are not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Independent arclength endpoints on nondegenerate triangle boundaries only; not motion-invariant random-line chords, and no analogous result for general polygons is asserted.
title: A sharp total-variation barrier for random chord midpoints of triangles
